about_the_game:
Grab your pickaxe and step into the boots of Miner Man, a mining simulator that blends action, progression, and strategy. Explore rich underground environments, dig through layers of rock, and uncover valuable resources waiting to be claimed.

Your journey doesn’t stop with mining alone - upgrade your tools to strike faster, dig deeper, and unlock greater rewards. As your operation grows, invest in contractors who will automate the grind, keeping your mines productive even while you plan your next move.

With every milestone, new mines become available, each offering tougher challenges and rarer treasures. From simple stone quarries to dangerous underground caverns, progression means more risk, but also greater reward.

Whether you prefer hands-on digging or building an automated mining empire, Miner Man offers endless opportunities to grow, optimize, and dominate the underground world. How far will you dig to become the ultimate mining tycoon?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: 3GHz 4-Core or similar
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1050 or Radeon RX 570
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

short_description: Dig deep, upgrade your gear, and build your mining empire in Miner Man! Mine resources, hire contractors to automate the grind, and unlock new, challenging mines as you grow from rookie digger to legendary tycoon.
